claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG012325 reports PEID 12325, display name Gun, country Benin and primary language Gun (guw).
Glottolog identifies Gun with glottocode gunn1250 and ISO 639-3 code guw and lists Benin and Nigeria among its countries.

Independent linguistic and Beninese academic sources document Gungbe across Benin and Nigeria and describe it as a cross-border language of intercommunication, with scholarship also examining bilingualism and language maintenance.
claims.interpretationNote: The sociolinguistic literature covers particular border communities and should not be generalized into one current language-use pattern for every Gun community.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports Ethnoreligion as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG012325.
